__doc__: SOT-1754 declarative pipeline graph. Externalizes the role pipeline that run_auto.sh historically hard-coded (task-check → implementation → verification → acceptance → github → linear-report, bounded NEEDS_DEBUG back-edges, BLOCKED/NEEDS_USER_INPUT terminals) into data. Opt-in: run_auto.sh drives this graph only when PIPELINE_GRAPH is truthy; otherwise (and whenever this file is missing/invalid — fail-open) the serial bash loop runs unchanged. Node execution is unchanged either way: each node dispatches `run_worker.sh <role>`; this graph only decides where to go next. Engine/validator: src/lib/pipelineGraph.ts, CLI: `runner-cli pipeline-graph validate|begin|next`. Keys starting with __ are docs.
__events_doc__: Edge keys are report verdicts: the `## Next Action` token (READY_FOR_REVIEW / NEEDS_DEBUG / NEEDS_USER_INPUT / BLOCKED), NONE (no token parsed), and `*` (mandatory default). Nodes with verdict_source=acceptance additionally emit ACCEPTANCE_FAIL (machine verdict `## Acceptance: FAIL` — wins over any Next Action) and ACCEPTANCE_PASS (PASS and Next Action is not a human-stop); a missing acceptance verdict falls back to the Next Action token, mirroring the serial path's PIPELINE_WARN fallback (SOT-1558). Targets are node ids or the terminals __done__ (COMPLETED), __done_no_pr__ (successful no-op → COMPLETED_NO_PR), __stop__ (needs attention → COMPLETION_UNVERIFIED).
__bounds_doc__: Cycle bounding. The shared `debug` budget is the faithful mapping of the serial loop's single debug_cycles counter: EVERY back-edge (verification/acceptance → implementation, NEEDS_DEBUG re-verification) declares counts=debug, so loop-backs are bounded GLOBALLY at PIPELINE_MAX_DEBUG_CYCLES (default 2) across all loop kinds combined — identical to the serial gate. Exhaustion maps to __stop__ (PIPELINE_STOP, needs attention) without dispatching the target again. Per-node max_visits (= PIPELINE_MAX_DEBUG_CYCLES + 1 initial visit) is a pure backstop on the loop nodes; the budget always trips first.
